name: harnet5_and_harnet10
title: Self-supervised Learning for Human Activity Recognition Using 700,000 Person-days of Wearable Data

weights.note: Both released trunks are evaluated as separate representation rows. Their EvaClassifier heads are not part of the common enrollment protocol.

input_contract.resampler: linear interpolation matching the released preprocessing
input_contract.note: harnet5 uses 3 x 150 and harnet10 uses 3 x 300. Each row is center-cropped or wrap-padded to its own published input. The exported feature is the feature_extractor tensor immediately before EvaClassifier; for these fixed inputs its temporal dimension is one.

note: The primary common-protocol table reports official HARNet-5 (512-d, ~4.2M trunk parameters) and HARNet-10 (1024-d, ~10.5M trunk parameters) independently. Neither row is presented as a reproduction of the paper's downstream task-specific classifier.
